title: 果蝇大脑，自己动起来
title_en: A fly brain that moves on its own

segments.zh: 这是一只果蝇。对，就是总在你家香蕉上开派对的那位。
segments.en: This is a fruit fly — yes, the one partying on your bananas.

segments.zh: 它的大脑比一粒芝麻还小，却装着将近十四万个神经元。
segments.en: Its brain is smaller than a sesame seed, yet holds almost 140,000 neurons.

segments.zh: 2024 年，科学家把这些神经元之间的连线，一根一根全画了出来：五千多万个连接。
segments.en: In 2024 scientists mapped every wire between them: over 50 million connections.

segments.zh: 这张图叫“连接组”，相当于果蝇大脑的全套电路图。
segments.en: That map is the connectome — the fly brain's full circuit diagram.

segments.zh: 于是有人想：电路图都有了，能不能在电脑里，给它通上电？
segments.en: So someone asked: with the circuit diagram, can we switch it on in a computer?

segments.zh: 伯克利的团队真这么干了：用最简化的神经元，在一台笔记本电脑上跑整颗果蝇大脑。
segments.en: A Berkeley team did it: the simplest neurons, the whole fly brain, on a laptop.

segments.zh: 戳一下“尝到甜味”的神经元，模拟大脑就下令：伸嘴，开吃！
segments.en: Poke the 'sweet taste' neurons and the model orders: tongue out, eat!

segments.zh: 戳一下“被碰到”的神经元，它就开始……整理仪容。
segments.en: Poke the 'touch' neurons and it starts… grooming.

segments.zh: 2026 年，又有公司把这颗模拟大脑，接上了一个物理仿真的果蝇身体。
segments.en: In 2026 a company connected this model brain to a physics-simulated fly body.

segments.zh: 结果，虚拟果蝇自己伸腿、搓脚、低头喝水。
segments.en: And the virtual fly stretched its legs, rubbed its feet and drank.

segments.zh: 注意：没有人写过“请搓脚”这行代码。动作是从接线里冒出来的。
segments.en: Note: nobody wrote a line of code saying 'rub feet'. It came out of the wiring.

segments.zh: 不过，先别急着把自己上传。
segments.en: But don't upload yourself just yet.

segments.zh: 参数是调出来的；电路图里没有激素，也不会学习；这次演示当时还没有正式论文。
segments.en: Parameters were tuned; no hormones, no learning in the map; no paper yet at the time.

segments.zh: 而且，人脑的神经元，大约是果蝇的六十万倍。
segments.en: And a human brain has about 600,000 times as many neurons.

segments.zh: 所以今天的结论是：电路图很重要，但它还不是灵魂。嗯……也许吧。
segments.en: So today's conclusion: the circuit diagram matters — but it is not a soul. Probably.

elements.text: 伯克利 2024 · 最简化的神经元
伸腿 · 搓脚 · 喝水
动作是从“接线”里冒出来的
